domains.name: Demographics
domains.summary: Mother's single years of age, age recodes, imputed and reported flags for age, marital status, nativity, education, presentation at delivery, route/method of delivery, trial of labor.

domains.name: Maternal Complications

domains.summary: Mother’s race recodes and imputed flags for race.

domains.name: Transfer & Height
domains.summary: Indicators of mother being transferred to another facility and her height in total inches.

domains.summary: Flags indicating absence of abnormal conditions, infections, congenital anomalies, labor characteristics, maternal morbidity, risk factors.
